name: Bad Newt 60
author: mayurd8862
description: Neon rounded red button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, transform becomes translateY(-2px), box-shadow becomes 0 0 30px #e8617c,
              0 0 30px #e8617c,
              0 0 10px #e8617c inset.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bad Newt 60</title>
<style>
/* Bad Newt 60 by mayurd8862 — https://uiverse.io/mayurd8862/bad-newt-60 */
.button {
  padding: 0.6em 1.3em;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 18px;
  background-color: rgb(40, 40, 40);
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgb(232, 97, 124);
  color: aliceblue;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgb(232, 97, 124),
              0 0 25px rgb(232, 97, 124),
              0 0 5px rgb(232, 97, 124) inset;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgb(232, 97, 124),
              0 0 30px rgb(232, 97, 124),
              0 0 10px rgb(232, 97, 124) inset;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  NEON
</button>

</body>
</html>
